observations.behavior: Adds documentation describing the Trino opt-in and its behavior.
observations.code_quote: Selecting **PostHog (Trino)** loads the warehouse catalog into a schema/table tree, including columns on expansion. The catalog is discovered with the same user credential and access checks as native Trino queries. It does not include the default PostHog catalog or saved-query folders. Switching back to **PostHog (ClickHouse)** restores the default catalog. Discovery failures show a retry action instead of falling back to PostHog tables.
